notes: - **AssemblyAI is now available for meeting notes and the live transcript.** Add a key from the **AssemblyAI** tile in Speech services (it was marked Soon), choose **Universal-3.5 Pro** or the cheaper **Universal-2**, and press **Test**. Meeting notes tell the other people on a call apart, and the Live window streams to AssemblyAI too when it writes your notes, with the cost shown and no second provider billed. Your Dictionary words go along as key terms, and **Usage & cost** prices each combination. See [Speech models](/docs/speech-models/).
